nodes.label: S-165 Gate: 0.5.2 Web Markdown Detail View
Escape-First Zero-Dependency Markdown Renderer
nodes.rationale: 136-LOC zero-dependency renderer inside APP_JS escaping through esc() at every branch with class-only static tags, non-navigating links (no href under CSP posture), unicode-escaped backtick fences (u0060) to preserve template-literal integrity, and gated link matching (canLink) to avoid O(n^2) unmatched-bracket scans.
